Overview

Most is a city in Ústí nad Labem with a population of 64,000. A North Bohemian city known for its remarkable Gothic church relocation and the scenic Lake Most, a reclaimed mining area turned recreation spot. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
